lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

A Surrey, B.C., landscaping company is giving its employees the day off on Thursday when the much-hyped Grand Theft Auto VI video game finally releases, in what has been billed as perhaps the biggest entertainment launch ever, The Canadian Press reports.
Premier Doug Ford may no longer be enjoying the Trump bump that propelled his popularity for months, a new poll suggests, Toronto Star reports.
"I think (Russian President Vladimir Putin), and I hope the other side, would like to see an end of that war," he said.

Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 per share Wednesday, valuing the artificial intelligence giant at $1.5 trillion in the biggest Wall Street debut of all time, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
